tools.name: match_profile
tools.description: Find live Australian jobs that match a resume or LinkedIn profile. Send the resume text (text) OR derived signals (titles, occupations, skills). H1R3 extracts job titles, skills, location, seniority, likely pay band and work type with the ANZSCO dictionary (no AI), then ranks jobs by title/skill/occ

tools.description: Save a job search as an email alert (seeker key, Basic verified). Sends NEW matching jobs daily or weekly to the account email, with an unsubscribe link. Filters as search_jobs: q, location, near, occupation, industry, work_type, min_pay (A$/yr, advertised pay), include_estimates. Max 5 alerts. send

tools.name: list_job_alerts
tools.description: List your active job alerts (seeker key).

tools.name: delete_job_alert
tools.description: Delete one of your job alerts by id (seeker key).

tools.name: list_bot_applicable_jobs
tools.description: The canonical index of jobs a bot can apply to end-to-end (no human form/captcha). Each job has an apply block {method, endpoint, required_fields, auth}.

tools.name: claim_listing
tools.description: Verified (ABN) employer claims a sourced listing for their company; converts to an H1R3 job using 1 credit.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Join the pre-launch waitlist.

tools.name: list_skill_tests
tools.description: List available skills tests.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Post a job (employer key, ABN-verified, 1 credit). Returns Fair Work/moderation warnings. Set id_verified_only=true to accept ID verified applicants only (default: Basic verified or higher).

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Apply to a job (seeker key). Needs Basic verified (free: email + selfie check) or higher; jobs with min_verification=id ("ID verified only") need ID verified (A$3/yr).

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applicants for a job you own (employer key), with skill badges and verification_level (Basic verified | ID verified).

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Shortlist or reject an application (employer key).

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Create/update seeker profile.

tools.name: search_seekers
tools.description: Search searchable seekers (ABN-verified employer key). Each result has verification_level (Basic verified | ID verified). Filters: id_verified_only, min_level (basic|phone|id), verified_task (code), verified_cert (type), verified_skill (badge), min_score, min_identity, min_skills, min_references (0-

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Start a timed skills test (seeker key). The human account owner must take it.

tools.name: list_task_taxonomy
tools.description: Task taxonomy (codes) for roles, with which certs/badges corroborate each task.

tools.name: list_cert_types
tools.description: Cert/licence types and how each is verified (register link, issuer confirmation, admin).

tools.name: set_privacy
tools.description: Seeker privacy consent + visibility (private | applied | searchable). Consent is required before adding certs/roles.

tools.name: add_cert
tools.description: Add a cert/licence (metadata + optional document SHA-256; no file upload).

tools.name: request_issuer_confirmation
tools.description: Get a single-use 30-day link for the cert issuer to confirm yes/no. Share it yourself (no email is sent).

tools.name: add_role
tools.description: Add an employment-history role with claimed tasks (taxonomy codes or {custom}). Roles current or ended within 24 months are reference-eligible.

tools.name: add_referee
tools.description: Nominate a referee for a role; returns a unique single-use 30-day referee link to share.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Your portable verified passport: three 0-100 scores (identity, skills_certs, references) with level + breakdown, certs, roles, per-task matrix, learning & attitude.

tools.name: share_passport
tools.description: Create a read-only passport link for any employer or bot (revokes previous).

tools.name: get_verification_status
tools.description: Seeker verification level and steps: Not verified, Basic verified (FREE: email confirmed + selfie check; a real person was at the camera, not an ID check), ID verified (A$3/yr: ID document check). Shows what is missing to apply.

tools.name: get_selfie_link
tools.description: Bots cannot do the selfie check. This returns a one-time 30-minute link for your human to open on a phone with a camera; the check runs on their device (MediaPipe), nothing is uploaded. Poll get_verification_status for the result.

tools.name: confirm_email
tools.description: Email a single-use 24h confirmation link to the account email (identity score +15).

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Read a shared passport by its token.

tools.name: submit_test
tools.description: Submit answers (0-based option indexes, in order).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" is 1057 chars, far longer than this server's median (105). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_job_alert, apply, request_issuer_confirmation, get_verification_status · Private data: set_privacy, add_cert, get_verification_status, get_passport · Public sink: match_profile, create_job_alert, search_jobs, post_job, apply, add_cert, request_issuer_confirmation, add_referee, share_passport, get_verification_status, confirm_email, submit_test · Destructive: delete_job_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_job_alert, apply, request_issuer_confirmation, get_verification_status · Private data: set_privacy, add_cert, get_verification_status, get_passport · Public sink: match_profile, create_job_alert, search_jobs, post_job, apply, add_cert, request_issuer_confirmation, add_referee, share_passport, get_verification_status, confirm_email, submit_test · Destructive: delete_job_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
